decisions.reason: As a flagship product line for digital patient intake and consent, it is central to our product direction and regulatory compliance.
It leverages existing training resources and strengthens customer relationships, so it remains aligned with our support strategy.
It improves customer support efficiency and builds on our established support capabilities, making it a valuable operational tool.
Analytics supports efficient practice management and differentiates our software, so it is a strategic priority.
A complete bundle simplifies purchasing and is close to our established core offering, making it an important sales package.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from our core software and competes in an unfamiliar network-dependent market, so we will drop it to focus resources.
